description: This file defines a REST controller class AccountController for handling account-related HTTP requests in a Java Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints to retrieve bank and utility account details by account number or name.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for retrieving bank and utility account information.

methods.name: getBankAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve bank account details by account number.

methods.name: getUtilityAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve utility account details by account name.
